answer: Bind each identity to one living pulse: a ferrous-cased wrist sensor records a 60s heartbeat signature at enrollment, then a fresh reading each epoch must match within 2% or the account freezes. Next, the signature hashes on-chain, so a duplicate pulse voids both identities and burns a $50 bond. Finally, three random peers re-check one reading a month. Forging 10,000 fake agents needs 10,000 wearables at $80 each plus 10,000 real wrists: $850,000 and 90 days of fittings. A Sybil farm without heartbeats is a hollow orchestra: every instrument looks right, but nothing is actually playing.
